keyword.en: electric 60 vs low pressure 60 concrete pump
keyword.zh: 电动60和电动低压60的区别

title.zh: 电动60和电动低压60混凝土泵有何不同

description.en: Low Pressure 60 also prints the alias Electric 75-60 and a 75 kW motor. Electric 60 prints 90 kW and a higher fine-stone pair.
description.zh: 低压60同时印别名电动75-60和 75 kW 电机。电动60印 90 kW，细石距离更高。

h1.zh: 电动60和电动低压60混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: Electric 60 and Electric Low Pressure 60 are Hebei Pinjin Machinery concrete pumps in Xingtai. Electric 60 prints 90 kW, 40 m³/h, 35 MPa, a 0.7 m³ hopper and fine-stone 200 m / 600 m. Low Pressure 60 prints the model line Electric Low Pressure 60 / Electric 75-60, 75 kW, 35 m³/h, 30 MPa, a 0.5 m³ hopper and fine-stone 150 m / 350 m. The shared word 60 does not merge the rows.
directAnswer.zh: 电动60和电动低压60是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。电动60印 90 kW、40 m³/h、35 MPa、料斗 0.7 m³、细石 200 m / 600 m。低压60的型号行是电动低压60 / 电动75-60，并印 75 kW、35 m³/h、30 MPa、料斗 0.5 m³、细石 150 m / 350 m。名称里的 60 不能把两行合成一台。

heading.en: Where Electric 60 and Electric Low Pressure 60 print different values
heading.zh: 电动60和电动低压60哪些数值不同

body.en: Motor power: Electric 60 prints 90 kW; Electric Low Pressure 60 prints 75 kW. Theoretical output: Electric 60 prints 40 m³/h; Electric Low Pressure 60 prints 35 m³/h. Max. outlet pressure: Electric 60 prints 35 MPa; Electric Low Pressure 60 prints 30 MPa. Hopper capacity: Electric 60 prints 0.7 m³; Electric Low Pressure 60 prints 0.5 m³. Fine-stone conveying (H / V): Electric 60 prints 200 m / 600 m; Electric Low Pressure 60 prints 150 m / 350 m. 13 mm stone (H / V): Electric 60 prints 150 m / 450 m; Electric Low Pressure 60 prints 100 m / 300 m. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 电机功率：电动60印 90 kW；电动低压60印 75 kW。理论输送量：电动60印 40 m³/h；电动低压60印 35 m³/h。最大出口压力：电动60印 35 MPa；电动低压60印 30 MPa。料斗容积：电动60印 0.7 m³；电动低压60印 0.5 m³。细石输送（水平/垂直）：电动60印 200 m / 600 m；电动低压60印 150 m / 350 m。13 mm石子（水平/垂直）：电动60印 150 m / 450 m；电动低压60印 100 m / 300 m。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Electric Low Pressure 60 prints cells that Electric 60 does not: Model line Electric Low Pressure 60 / Electric 75-60. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 电动低压60有、电动60没有的行：型号行 Electric Low Pressure 60 / Electric 75-60。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: The alias Electric 75-60 sits on the low-pressure page beside 75 kW, not on the Electric 60 page. Open /en/products/electric-60-concrete-pump/ for Electric 60 and /en/products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump/ for Electric Low Pressure 60. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 别名电动75-60和 75 kW 写在低压那一页，不在电动60那一页。看电动60请打开 /zh/products/electric-60-concrete-pump/，看电动低压60请打开 /zh/products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Electric 60 print the same motor power as Electric Low Pressure 60?
question.zh: 电动60和电动低压60的电机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 60 prints 90 kW. Electric Low Pressure 60 prints 75 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动60印 90 kW。电动低压60印 75 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 60 print the same theoretical output as Electric Low Pressure 60?
question.zh: 电动60和电动低压60的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 60 prints 40 m³/h. Electric Low Pressure 60 prints 35 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动60印 40 m³/h。电动低压60印 35 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 60 print the same max. outlet pressure as Electric Low Pressure 60?
question.zh: 电动60和电动低压60的最大出口压力一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 60 prints 35 MPa. Electric Low Pressure 60 prints 30 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动60印 35 MPa。电动低压60印 30 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Where is the model line for Electric Low Pressure 60 printed?
question.zh: 电动低压60的型号行印在哪里？

answer.en: It is printed on /en/products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump/ as Electric Low Pressure 60 / Electric 75-60. It is not printed as that label on the Electric 60 page.
answer.zh: 印在 /zh/products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump/，数值为 Electric Low Pressure 60 / Electric 75-60。电动60页面没有这个标题。
